sentences.text:
: 
G.A. 
 Court No. - 12
 Hon'Ble Pankaj Bhatia, J. 
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
2.  The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.479 of 2007, under Sections 498A, 304B IPC and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, Police Station Inayat Nagar, District Faizabad/ Ayodhya.
3. In terms of the FIR, it was alleged that the daughter of the informant was married to the applicant on 09.10.2005,
Subsequently, on account of non-payment of dowry, she was killed by the entire matrimonial family.
The cause of death, as per the postmortem report, was ante mortem hanging.
After investigation, final report was submitted against which, a protest petition was filed.
The applicant is in custody since 12.06.2023.
4. Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the bail prayer.

5. Considering the postmortem report and the fact that the FIR itself was lodged through an application under Section 156(3) of Cr.P.C. some times in the year 2007; the applicant is in custody since 12.06.2023 and has no criminal antecedents, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Vinod Kori be released on bail in the abovesaid first information report number on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(Pankaj Bhatia,J.) November 7, 2025 akverma  Vinod Kori vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.
